name: Pathfinder
description: Finds a path through a level with the real game physics and exports a Mega Hack v9 (GDR) macro

ticks-per-step.name: Decision step (ticks)
ticks-per-step.description: How often the bot may change input, in physics ticks (240 per second). 4 = every 60 FPS frame, 1 = every tick (most precise, slowest).

budget.name: CPU time per frame (ms)
budget.description: How much time per real frame is spent simulating. Higher = faster search, lower FPS.

max-checkpoints.name: Max checkpoints in memory
max-checkpoints.description: Older checkpoints are dropped and replayed from the start when needed.

dead-end-ticks.name: Dead end threshold (ticks)
dead-end-ticks.description: If the bot must go back more than this many ticks after dying, the spot is reported as a dead end.

smart-order.name: Smart input order
smart-order.description: Predicts the trajectory for the current gamemode before every decision and tries the input that survives longer first. Much fewer backtracks.

lookahead-ticks.name: Smart order lookahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: How far the prediction looks ahead when choosing which input to try first.

verify.name: Verify path
verify.description: Replays the found inputs from the start (exactly like a bot would) before saving the macro.

trajectory.name: Draw found path
trajectory.description: Draw the current path (green) and deaths (red)

draw-prediction.name: Draw predicted trajectory
draw-prediction.description: Draw where the player goes if the button is held (blue) or released (orange), for the current gamemode.

prediction-in-game.name: Show trajectory while playing
prediction-in-game.description: Also draw the predicted trajectory during normal play (not only while pathfinding).

export-dir.name: Macro folder
export-dir.description: Mega Hack v9 reads replays from the 'replays' folder next to GeometryDash.exe.

export-format.name: Macro format
export-format.description: gdr = GDR msgpack (Mega Hack v9 native), gdr.json = GDR JSON, both = save both files.
